question.text: Which one is not an allylic halide?

solution.text: 1-chloro but-1-ene <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mtext>C</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>H</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>-</mo><mtext>C</mtext><mtext>H</mtext><mo>=</mo><mtext>C</mtext><mtext>H</mtext><mo>-</mo><mtext>C</mtext><mtext>l</mtext></mrow></mfenced></math> is classified as a vinylic halide.
